negative_findings.description: Searches in Czech and English did not surface a dedicated, separately addressable 'issuer announcements / oznámení emitentů' index page on pse.cz distinct from the general /zpravy (/en/news) feed. Fetching the MONETA ISIN detail page showed Overview, Tick Data, Historical Data, Company Profile, News and a corporate-calendar reference, but no announcements sub-page.
negative_findings.result_summary: PSE appears to route issuer regulated disclosures to the general news feed and out to issuer IR sites / ČNB CUri rather than hosting a MAR filing archive of its own. Unverified — the site is JS-heavy and a deeper crawl may reveal one.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A collector should treat ČNB CUri as the authoritative filing archive and pse.cz only as a timing tripwire; assuming PSE holds the filings would create silent gaps.

negative_findings.description: The ČNB CUri/OAM search application URL (oam.cnb.cz SIPRESWEB entry point) was obtained from search-result text and the ČNB landing page rather than by a direct successful fetch of the application itself.
negative_findings.result_summary: Recorded as a candidate with confidence 0.8; liveness and the exact query-parameter contract must be established by the deterministic verification pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: This is the single most important source in the cell; if its endpoint has moved, the whole primary-filing channel silently fails.

negative_findings.description: No RSS/Atom or public API was identified for any of the Czech-side sources in this cell (pse.cz, investors.moneta.cz, kb.cz, csob.cz, ČNB CUri) during this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: All Czech-side collection is likely to require HTML scraping plus PDF text extraction.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Drives collector design and cost; also raises brittleness risk versus the Austrian/Belgian parents where EQS and Euronext offer stable permalinks.

negative_findings.description: Česká spořitelna, ČSOB and Raiffeisenbank a.s. have no Czech equity listing, so no CZ-level MAR management-change disclosure exists for them; only bond-issuer disclosures and parent-level (Erste/KBC/RBI) ad-hoc releases cover their leadership.
negative_findings.result_summary: For three of the four largest CZ banks, this cell can only deliver A5 signal via foreign-parent disclosure plus annual-report governance chapters.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Sets a structural ceiling on this cell's coverage; CZ-entity board changes for these banks must be picked up by other cells (commercial register, ČNB licensing lists, press).

coverage_gaps.description: No listed-issuer disclosure channel exists for CZ payment institutions and fintechs (e.g. non-bank PSPs, e-money institutions) — none are PSE issuers, so MAR-driven leadership disclosure does not reach the payments half of the sector.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Route payments-sector A5 signal to non-market cells (commercial register / obchodní rejstřík, ČNB registry of payment institutions, company newsrooms, LinkedIn).

coverage_gaps.description: The Czech statutory corporate registry (obchodní rejstřík / sbírka listin at justice.cz), which records the legally effective appointment and removal of představenstvo and dozorčí rada members and holds AGM minutes, was not enumerated in this pass because it sits outside the 'regulated market disclosure' cell boundary.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Confirm another cell owns or.justice.cz; if not, add it — it is the ground truth that closes the gap left by unlisted CZ bank subsidiaries.

coverage_gaps.description: Historical backfill of issuer announcements older than roughly a decade was not established; ČNB notes pre-31-July-2009 regulated information sits in a separate legacy database whose URL was not captured.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Locate and record the ČNB legacy pre-2009 repository endpoint and the RM-SYSTÉM pagination bounds to enable a full historical leadership timeline.

coverage_gaps.description: German-language ad-hoc disclosure by the Austrian parents (Erste, RBI, VIG) and Wiener Börse issuer news were not searched in German; the run's language scope is cs+en, but the legally binding ad-hoc text for these issuers is often German-first.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Either extend the language scope to de for the Austrian parent sub-cell, or accept the English translations with a documented latency caveat.

coverage_gaps.description: Feasibility of automated querying against ČNB CUri (form-based Oracle app) and of PDF parsing for AGM notices was not tested.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a technical spike: one scripted CUri query for Moneta plus one PDF extraction of a KB pozvánka na valnou hromadu, and record the parsing pattern for agenda item 'volba člena dozorčí rady'.

brief: The CZ regulated-market disclosure channel for banking A5 signal has a clear two-tier shape: ČNB's Centrální úložiště regulovaných informací (CUri/OAM) is the statutory archive of every MAR inside-information item, AGM convocation and annual report for Czech-listed issuers, while the Prague Stock Exchange functions mainly as a timing tripwire that points onward to issuer IR sites. Only MONETA Money Bank and Komerční banka give genuinely Czech, calendar-driven leadership disclosure — their 'povinně uveřejňované informace' and 'valná hromada' pages carry AGM agendas naming supervisory-board candidates roughly a month before appointment, the cell's rare forward-looking signal. For Česká spořitelna, ČSOB and Raiffeisenbank the CZ entity is unlisted, so coverage depends on the foreign parents' ad-hoc feeds (Erste, KBC, RBI, Société Générale, VIG) plus their EQS/Euronext mirrors, which are English-first and reliably dated. Czech-side collection will be scraping-and-PDF work with no RSS or API found, and the biggest structural gap is that payment institutions and unlisted bank subsidiaries fall entirely outside this cell and must be covered by the commercial register and regulator-registry cells.
